English: I embrace the present opertunity [opportunity] of answering your kind letter and hope it will find you enjoying the blessing of good health, as this leaves me middling at present.

Thanks be to God for His mercies I am still very busy at the nets and have very little time to spare .Mrs Clague and the little boys are pretty well and Mr Clague himself is improving a little. They all desire to be kindly remembered to you. I am expecting my son home from Liverpool tonight. He is coming to see me before I go away. Mr Keig desires to be remembered to you. I am glad that you got a good passage home —  it was a very good passage home it was a very quick one to travel so many miles in so short a time. I hope we will be ready for sea in another week or so, I would much rather stop at home but I must work while I am able. I have no strange news to tell you at present, so I must conclude and
